propositions: Jira Data Center rate-limiting (HTTP 429) is not honoured; the transport fails on first occurrence instead of respecting Retry-After headers
rate-limit retry logic cannot be static because the limit is admin-configured per-instance and unknowable at build time

429 retry must not reach mutations via _with_connection_retry (which fronts create_issue and ~10 other write sites) because a 429 can arrive after the server begins a write, risking duplicate-issue reintroduction
retry logic must be scoped to idempotent reads only, via per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF, so future mutations cannot inherit the retry by omission
implementation required extraction of retry/error cluster from 789-line transport.py (at locked 800 LOC cap) into separate adapters/jira_datacenter/retry.py before 429 policy could be added
